snippet.title: Granny: Recaptured (UNOFFICIAL REMAKE)
snippet.description:
Buy the original game at https://store.steampowered.com/app/962400/Granny/
Recaptured available for owners of Granny at:
https://gamejolt.com/games/GrannyRecaptured/967513
https://discord.gg/SaGAy5v9jC

(Note: This port predated Granny v1.3's release on Steam! These days, the official port is available and the games are on sale again 😊)

Original description:

Ever since the release of Granny v1.8, I've been hard at working porting all the new content to PC. Rather than just piling everything into a big mod, I decided to make a completely new port of the game, with heaps of improvements and new features.

Think of it as being like The Twins PC port, but for Granny v1.8, combined with BMP 2.0.
